turns.text: Hi. The print was delivered to the old flat. I'd like to change the delivery address on that order now.
I can help with that. To find your order, please send me the order number (it looks like SC-1234) and the email address the order was placed with. I also need the new delivery address.
Order SC-5209, email cressida.paunelu@example.com. The new delivery address would be Lindenweg 9, Graz.

Thank you, Cressida. I have checked order SC-5209. It has already been shipped and delivered, so I cannot change its delivery address. Under our policy, the address can only change until the order ships. If you need help with the delivered print, such as a damage claim, I can help with that.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

turns.text: I do not want a return. I only want the delivery address updated after delivery.

I understand, but I cannot update the delivery address on SC-5209. Our policy allows address changes only until the order ships, and this order has already been delivered. I have not filed any request. If you have a different need, such as a problem with the print itself, tell me and I will help.
